notes: With the production stability gate enabled, one A frame must leave pending B alive. Returning to B must reuse that request and interrupt the A candidate. Two consecutive A frames then cancel B, establish a new A identity, and allow B to recur without the cancelled attempt's throttle; late B cannot overwrite the new sentence.
